1.w: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah. A Maskil. O God, with our ears we have heard; our fathers have recounted to us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.

2.w: You, with Your hand, dispossessed the nations, and You planted them; You afflicted the peoples and sent them forth.

3.w: For they did not gain possession of the land by their sword, and their arm did not bring salvation to them; but [it was] Your right hand, and Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You delighted in them.

4.w: You are my King, O God; Command deliverances for Jacob.

5.w: Through You we push back our adversaries; by Your name we trample those rising against us.

6.w: For not in my bow do I trust, and my sword will not save me.

7.w: For You have saved us from our adversaries, and those hating us, You have put to shame.

8.w: In God we have boasted all the day, and we will praise Your name forever. Selah

9.w: yet You have rejected us and put us to shame, and You do not go forth with our armies.

10.w: You make us turn back from the adversary, and those hating us have taken plunder for themselves.

11.w: You have appoint us for food like sheep, and among the nations You have scattered us.

12.w: You sell Your people with no profit, and You do not gain increase by their price.

13.w: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.

14.w: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

15.w: All the day, my disgrace [is] before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,

16.w: at the voice of a reproacher and reviler, from the face of the enemy and avenger.

17.w: All this has come upon us, and we have not forgotten You, and we have not dealt falsely with Your covenant.

18.w: Our heart has not turned back, [nor] our steps turned aside from Your path.

19.w: Yet You have crushed us in the place of jackals, and You have covered over us with the shadow of death.

20.w: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a strange god,

21.w: would not God search this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.

22.w: Yet for Your sake we are killed all the day; we are reckoned as sheep for the slaughter.

23.w: Rouse Yourself! Why do You sleep, O Lord? Awake! Do not reject [us] forever.

24.w: Why do You hide Your face? You forget our affliction and our oppression.

25.w: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly has clung to the ground.

26.w: Rise up as helper to us, and redeem us for the sake of Your loving devotion!
